question: Where’s the closest hospital that comes up heading toward the Colonnade Hotel, Boston, MA from Copicut Woods Parking, Westport, MA?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Copicut Woods Parking%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Westport%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), destination AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Colonnade Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Boston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), bearings AS ( SELECT (SELECT geometry FROM origin) AS origin_geom, (SELECT geometry FROM destination) AS dest_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM origin), (SELECT geometry FROM destination))) AS main_bearing ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, bearings AS b WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital' AND b.origin_geom IS NOT NULL AND b.dest_geom IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(b.origin_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography, 150000) -- Pre-filter hospitals within 150km of the origin AND ( -- Calculate the shortest angular difference between the main bearing (origin to destination) -- and the bearing from the origin to the hospital. -- Check if this angular difference is within +/- 45 degrees. ABS( (degrees(ST_Azimuth(b.origin_geom, p.geometry)) - b.main_bearing + 540) % 360 - 180 ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(b.origin_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
